errata.reason: Source-review erratum, 2026-11-14: the claim that accounts receivable nearly doubled (+82.3%) compares different scopes. The vendor December 2025 Accounts Receivable 17,212 excludes Other Receivables 8,722; together they are Total Receivables 25,934. At March 2026 the vendor Accounts Receivable 31,384 equals its Total Receivables 31,384, while Other Receivables is a dash, not a measured zero. The filing reports the combined Trade and other receivables line consistently: 25,934 at December 31, 2025 to 31,384 at March 31, 2026, +5,450 / 25,934 = 21.0149% QoQ (21.0% rounded). The represented March 31, 2025 comparable is 32,004, so the same combined line fell 620 / 32,004 = 1.9373% YoY (1.9%). These are consolidated point-in-time NOK million balances. They do not establish pure trade-receivables growth; do not relabel 21.0% as accounts-receivable-only growth or reuse 82.3% as a clean measure.

errata.reason: The invalid near-doubling magnitude propagated from business-model 11 through earnings 08 EQ1/SC1, earnings 99, final_thesis, memo and audit_dossier. Vendor DSO 33.0 days (FY2025) and 56.7 days (LTM March 2026) are reported vendor figures, but their underlying receivables scope and averaging method have not been reconciled across the reporting split. A measured 23.7-day collection deterioration, a clean normalization to 33 days threshold, and the claim that the more quantified 08 read is necessarily better evidence are not established. Do not infer zero Other Receivables from the dash or invent a corrected DSO. The larger year-end-to-quarter-end aggregate balance alone does not prove collection deterioration; the same aggregate declined 1.9% YoY.
